title: The Day the Volcano Baked Bread
description: At the end of harvest, the village climbs above the clouds with empty baskets. The first loaf comes out of the mountain just as the sky turns violet.
alt: Flour-dusted hands lift a golden loaf from a glowing opening in a volcanic slope as people carry baskets above a violet cloud bank.
pairing: End-of-harvest bread festival × a volcano that serves as the village oven
